title: Open direct image under reduction of the ambient scheme
statement: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion, def-pc-scheme]. Let $r:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ and $s:U_{\mathrm{red}}\to U$ be their reductions [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], and let $j_{\mathrm{red}}:U_{\mathrm{red}}\hookrightarrow X_{\mathrm{red}}$ be the induced open immersion. For any commutative ring $\Lambda$ and any sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], there is a $\Lambda$-linear isomorphism, natural in $F$, $$j_*F\ \cong\ r_*j_{\mathrm{red},*}s^{-1}F.$$ Here direct and inverse image are those of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] for constant coefficient rings. No reducedness, Noetherianity, finiteness or constructibility assumption on $X$, $\Lambda$ or $F$ is imposed.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph, reduction comparison before Noetherian induction

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-pbc-reduction-universal-homeomorphism to U. Its reduction s = U.nilradical.subschemeι is a surjective closed immersion, hence a universal homeomorphism. The induced reduction map j_red = (s ≫ j).liftNilradical satisfies j_red ≫ r = s ≫ j by Scheme.Hom.liftNilradical_subschemeι. This is the universal property of reduction; no open-immersion property is needed for this equality.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph, reduction comparison before Noetherian induction

proof.text: Use the coefficient-generic isEquivalence_upperStar from prop-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-topos with A = ModuleCat Λ and the universal homeomorphism s. The adjunction s^* ⊣ s_* therefore has invertible unit, by the general adjunction theorem for equivalences. Let e : Id ≅ s^* ⋙ s_* be this unit isomorphism. All of its components are morphisms of module sheaves, so linearity requires no separate lifting from abelian sheaves.

source.place: Tag 03SI, topological invariance, applied to module-valued sheaves

proof.text: Whisker e on the right by j_*, obtaining j_* ≅ s^* ⋙ s_* ⋙ j_*, with the functor left unitor and associator inserted. The coefficient-generic lowerStarComp from lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition gives s_* ⋙ j_* ≅ (s ≫ j)_*. Apply lowerStarComp again to j_red and r with specified composite s ≫ j, using the equality in step 1, and invert it to get (s ≫ j)_* ≅ j_red,* ⋙ r_*. Whisker this composite on the left by s^*. Transitivity gives the requested natural isomorphism. Naturality and module linearity hold because every factor is a natural isomorphism between ModuleCat Λ-valued sheaf functors.
